title: broadcast profiles_changed
description: The profile model changed – profiles (created, renamed, rules, deleted, suggestion added/applied, default profiles) and/or the profile state of devices (assignment, adjustments incl. expiry, own area, remote PIN, bulk). Admin UIs reload the profile list, device list and open device pages; the integration treats it as refresh trigger. The affected devices themselves get client_config_updated (targeted).

profile_ids.description: Changed profiles (sorted); empty when only devices changed.

client_ids.description: Devices whose effective rules changed (sorted); empty when only profile metadata changed.
